subject.title: [Feature]: Standardize skill data directory convention (configPaths) under ~/.openclaw/

question: Should OpenClaw expose a first-class writable data location for skills, and should that live as plugin state/KV, a ClawHub authoring convention, or a new skill metadata/runtime placeholder?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing the storage owner creates a public skill-author contract and could affect state layout, migration, privacy, and ClawHub validation policy.

options.title: Define a core skill data contract
options.body: Add one documented skill-owned data contract with install/runtime/docs/tests and any required migration or doctor behavior.

options.title: Use plugin state instead
options.body: Steer writable runtime data to code plugins and plugin runtime state APIs, while keeping bundle-style skills declarative.

options.title: Make it ClawHub guidance only
options.body: Document and validate a package-author convention in ClawHub without adding new OpenClaw runtime behavior yet.

recommendation.title: Define a core skill data contract
recommendation.body: Add one documented skill-owned data contract with install/runtime/docs/tests and any required migration or doctor behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skill metadata, tools-dir, docs, and ClawHub install history make this the strongest routing candidate for the storage/API direction.
